page_title: FIO 2-1 GEN | Fiorentina v Genoa 02/02/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+5' Morten Frendrup (Genoa) clips an inviting cross into the box, but there's no one in a position to get on the end of it. The ball goes out of play and Fiorentina will have a goal kick.
90+3' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Aaron Martin (Genoa). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.
90+1' Dangerous play by Koni De Winter (Genoa). Giuseppe Collu blows his whistle for a foul. Fiorentina have a free kick.
90+1' Koni De Winter (Genoa) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
90' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
88' Junior Messias (Genoa) fizzes over a cross which doesn't cause any problems. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Fiorentina.

87' Koni De Winter (Genoa) commits a foul on his opponent and it looks like it should be the other way around at first glance, but the referee makes the right decision in awarding a free kick to the other team. It's a free kick to Fiorentina in a dangerous position.
83' We are about to witness a substitution. Christian Kouame (Fiorentina) is replacing Moise Kean.
82' Here is a change. Patrizio Masini is going off and Patrick Vieira gives the last tactical orders to Milan Badelj (Genoa).
82' It will be a substitution. Jeff Ekhator (Genoa) is ready to enter the pitch as Stefano Sabelli walks off.
82' Morten Frendrup (Genoa) commits a foul and Giuseppe Collu immediately signals a free kick. It's a free kick to Fiorentina, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
80' Luca Ranieri (Fiorentina) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee immediately stops play. A free kick to Genoa.
79' Koni De Winter (Genoa) fouls his opponent and receives a yellow card from the referee, but he is clearly not happy with the decision.
76' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Genoa.
74' Giuseppe Collu shows a yellow card to Pietro Comuzzo (Fiorentina), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
73' The referee blows his whistle after Stefano Sabelli (Genoa) does a good impression of a basketball player and handles the ball. There is a free kick near the sideline to Fiorentina.
71' Lucas Beltran comes off the pitch to be replaced by Fabiano Parisi (Fiorentina).
71' A pass by Caleb Ekuban (Genoa) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
70' Dodo (Fiorentina) is unlucky with a low drive from the edge of the box. A decent save by Nicola Leali stops the ball from hitting the middle of the net.

70' It looks like Vitinha (Genoa) saw red with that tackle. Giuseppe Collu won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul. Free kick. Fiorentina will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.

69' Koni De Winter (Genoa) wastes a great chance from the resulting corner. He times his header superbly when he leaps high to meet a precise cross, but can't aim better than into the middle of the goal, straight into the arms of the goalkeeper.
68' Corner kick. Aaron Martin (Genoa) is ready to send the ball into the box.
68' Aaron Martin (Genoa) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety. Genoa have been awarded a corner kick.
66' The substitution is prepared. Caleb Ekuban (Genoa) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Morten Thorsby.
66' Patrick Vieira has decided to make a change. Junior Messias (Genoa) replaces Fabio Miretti.
65' Marin Pongracic (Fiorentina) jumps inside the box to meet the resulting set piece and aims a header towards the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper shows his reflexes and makes a superb save.
65' The linesman makes the right call and Fiorentina will have a corner.

64' Dodo (Fiorentina) plants a goal-bound header towards the right post after a nice cross inside the box, but one of the defenders reacts superbly and makes a timely interception. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Fiorentina.
63' Koni De Winter (Genoa) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Giuseppe Collu has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle. A free kick has been awarded to Fiorentina.
61' Fabio Miretti (Genoa) does well on the edge of the box to find space and powers a shot in on goal that just goes over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Fiorentina will have a goal kick.
61' Vitinha (Genoa) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
61' Morten Frendrup (Genoa) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.
60' Morten Thorsby (Genoa) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
60' Andrea Pinamonti (Genoa) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
59' Lucas Beltran (Fiorentina) probably handled the ball. A free kick is awarded to Genoa.
59' Giuseppe Collu has a clear sight and sees a foul from Dodo (Fiorentina). Genoa will take a free kick near the side line.

59' Fabio Miretti (Genoa) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his strike wasn't accurate at all and the ball went well over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Fiorentina will have a goal kick.
56' We are about to witness a subsitution. Pietro Comuzzo (Fiorentina) for Amir Richardson.
56' Morten Thorsby (Genoa) was too forceful with his tackle and Giuseppe Collu interrupted the game to signal a free kick. Fiorentina are awarded a free kick.

55' 2 - 1 Koni De Winter (Genoa) jumps highest inside the box to meet the resulting corner kick by Aaron Martin. His well-placed header ends up in the top left corner, leaving the goalkeeper flapping in the wind. 2:1.
55' A pass into the penalty area from Fabio Miretti (Genoa) is intercepted by the defence. The ball goes out of play and Genoa have been awarded a corner kick.
54' Vitinha (Genoa) finds himself free inside the box and pulls the trigger, but his effort is brilliantly stopped by one of the defending players.
54' Aaron Martin (Genoa) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.
53' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Genoa, is intercepted by one of the defenders. Genoa have a corner.
53' Amir Richardson (Fiorentina) commits an ugly tackle on his opponent, but there is no caution from the referee. Genoa are awarded the free kick.
48' The foul by Michael Folorunsho (Fiorentina) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Giuseppe Collu.
48' Patrizio Masini (Genoa) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Giuseppe Collu signals. It's a free kick to Fiorentina, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
47' One of the players from Fiorentina times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
46' Patrick Vieira makes a switch. Vitinha is coming on in place of Maxwel Cornet (Genoa) at the start of the second period.
46' The second half has just started.
45+2' Giuseppe Collu blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+1' Albert Gudmundsson (Fiorentina) creates space for himself on the edge of the box and smacks a hard shot towards the middle of the goal, but it's an easy save for Nicola Leali.
45' We will have 1 min. of added time.
44' Giuseppe Collu interrupts the game. One of the players from Genoa won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair. Fiorentina win a free kick.
43' Michael Folorunsho (Fiorentina) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Giuseppe Collu blows for a foul. Genoa are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
41' A lofted cross from Stefano Sabelli (Genoa) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
37' What a big chance! Maxwel Cornet (Genoa) picks up an inch-perfect pass inside the box and skies the ball well over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Fiorentina.
37' Aaron Martin (Genoa) steps up to send the ball in.
36' A cross from Moise Kean (Fiorentina) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety. The ball goes out of play. Fiorentina are awarded a corner kick.
36' Giuseppe Collu blows for a foul after Michael Folorunsho (Fiorentina) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball. Genoa have a free kick.

34' Fiorentina are playing possession football and controlling the game at present. They are exchanging inch-perfect passes from player to player, making it difficult for the opposition to win the ball.
32' David de Gea pulls off a superb save! He leapt to block the shot Maxwel Cornet (Genoa) fired on target from the rebound. His effort from inside the box was directed low to the middle of the goal.
32' Fabio Miretti (Genoa) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.
31' Andrea Pinamonti (Genoa) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders. The referee signals a corner kick to Genoa.
30' 2 - 0 Goal! Robin Gosens pulls the ball back for Albert Gudmundsson (Fiorentina) on the edge of the box, and he beats the keeper with a fine strike into the middle of the goal. 2:0.
28' Rough tackle by Aaron Martin (Genoa). The referee blows his whistle for a foul. Fiorentina win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
25' Fabio Miretti (Genoa) takes the free kick but it is cleared by the first defender.
24' Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) makes a rough challenge and Giuseppe Collu blows his whistle for a foul. Genoa have a free kick.
23' Dodo (Fiorentina) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
23' Michael Folorunsho (Fiorentina) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
21' Fabio Miretti (Genoa) floats the free kick into the box, but it's easily cleared by the first man.
21' A player from Fiorentina commits a rough challenge. Giuseppe Collu blows for a foul and keeps the game under control. Genoa have been awarded a free kick.
19' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Genoa comes to nothing.
18' Aaron Martin (Genoa) unleashes a shot from the free kick, but blazes it over. This is a perfect example of a wasted chance. The ball goes out of play and Fiorentina will have a goal kick.
17' Giuseppe Collu shows the yellow card to Lucas Beltran (Fiorentina) for a heavy challenge.
9' 1 - 0 A cross from the free kick is whipped deep into the box by Rolando Mandragora and Moise Kean (Fiorentina) gets in a shot, sending the ball inside the right post. 1:0.
8' Giuseppe Collu blows his whistle and signals a foul after Koni De Winter (Genoa) brought his opponent down. A free kick has been awarded to Fiorentina.
6' Amir Richardson (Fiorentina) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision! Genoa earn a free kick.
4' It’s the correct decision – NO PENALTY for Fiorentina! VAR comes to the rescue of referee Giuseppe Collu and both teams have no complaints.

4' Play continues despite the shouts by some Fiorentina players for a penalty. Wait! Referee Giuseppe Collu interrupts the game right now and he will review that decision using VAR! Let's see what happens.
2' Michael Folorunsho (Fiorentina) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent. Genoa get a free kick.
2' There's a melee in the box, but the referee isn't interested in the appeals from Fiorentina for a penalty. Play continues.
2' Giuseppe Collu blows his whistle after Johan Vasquez (Genoa) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball. That's a free kick to Fiorentina.
1' Albert Gudmundsson (Fiorentina) commits an ugly challenge. The referee sees it and immediately blows his whistle. Genoa are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
1' The match has just started.
The players are out at last! Fiorentina will take the kick-off.
Giuseppe Collu will supervise the game today.
Show lineups We now know the starting lineups. You can find them in the match details of this match.
